story.fullStory:
Tommy Roe's "Dizzy" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Dizzy" is a song originally recorded by Tommy Roe that became an international hit single in 1969.

Instrumental backing was provided by the Los Angeles session musicians known as the Wrecking Crew.

Cowritten by Roe and Freddy Weller, "Dizzy" was a major hit on both sides of the Atlantic, reaching number one on the U.S.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 15 weeks on the chart.
